1.text: Abantu benshi bagerageje kuringaniza igitekerezo cy'imvaho cy'ibyemewe natwe rwose,

2.text: nk'uko twabibwiwe n'abahereye mbere bigitangira babyibonera ubwabo, kandi bakaba ari abigisha b'ijambo ry'Imana.

3.text: Nuko nanjye maze gukurikiranya byose neza mpereye ku bya mbere, nabonye ko ari byiza kubikwandikira uko bikurikirana wowe Tewofilo mwiza rwose,

4.text: kugira ngo umenye ibyo wigishijwe ko ari iby'ukuri.

5.text: Ku ngoma ya Herode umwami w'i Yudaya hariho umutambyi witwaga Zakariya, wo mu mugabane wa Abiya, wari ufite umugore wo mu bakobwa ba Aroni witwaga Elizabeti.

6.text: Bombi bari abakiranutsi imbere y'Imana, bagendera mu mategeko n'imihango by'Umwami Imana bose ari inyangamugayo.

7.text: Ariko ntibagiraga umwana kuko Elizabeti yari ingumba, kandi bombi bari bageze mu za bukuru.

8.text: Nuko ubwo Zakariya yari agikora umurimo w'ubutambyi imbere y'Imana, kuko umugabane we utahiwe n'igihe,

9.text: ubufindo buramufata nk'uko umugenzo w'abatambyi wari uri, ngo ajye mu rusengero rw'Uwiteka kōsa imibavu.

10.text: Muri icyo gihe cyo kōserezamo imibavu, rubanda rwasengeraga hanze.

11.text: Maze marayika w'Umwami Imana amubonekera ahagaze iburyo bw'igicaniro cy'imibavu,

13.text: ariko marayika aramubwira ati “Witinya Zakariya, kuko ibyo wasabye byumviswe. Umugore wawe Elizabeti azakubyarira umuhungu, uzamwite Yohana.

14.text: Azakubera umunezero n'ibyishimo, kandi benshi bazanezererwa kuvuka kwe,

15.text: kuko azaba mukuru imbere y'Umwami Imana. Ntazanywa vino cyangwa igishindisha cyose, kandi azuzuzwa Umwuka Wera ahereye akiva mu nda ya nyina.

16.text: Benshi mu Bisirayeli azabahindurira ku Mwami Imana yabo,

17.text: azagendera imbere yayo mu mwuka n'ububasha bya Eliya, asanganye imitima ya ba se n'iy'abana, n'abatumvira Imana azabayobora mu bwenge bw'abakiranutsi, ngo ategure ubwoko bwatunganirijwe Umwami Imana.”

18.text: Zakariya abaza marayika ati “Ibyo nzabibwirwa n'iki, ko ndi umusaza n'umugore wanjye akaba ari umukecuru?”

19.text: Marayika aramusubiza ati “Ndi Gaburiyeli uhagarara imbere y'Imana, kandi natumwe kuvugana nawe ngo nkubwire ubwo butumwa bwiza.

20.text: Nuko dore uragobwa ururimi, kandi ntuzabasha kuvuga kugeza umunsi ibyo bizakuberaho, kuko utemeye ko amagambo yanjye azasohora mu gihe cyayo.”

21.text: Abantu bategereza Zakariya, batangazwa n'uko atinze mu rusengero.

22.text: Maze asohotse ntiyabasha kuvugana na bo, bamenya yuko hari icyo yerekewe mu rusengero, akajya abacira amarenga akomeza kuba ikiragi.

23.text: Iminsi y'imirimo ye ishize asubira iwe.

24.text: Bukeye umugore we Elizabeti asama inda, abihisha amezi atanu

25.text: aravuga ati “Uku ni ko Umwami Imana yankoreye mu minsi yandebagamo, ikanteturura mu bantu.”

26.text: Mu kwezi kwa gatandatu, Marayika Gaburiyeli atumwa n'Imana mu mudugudu w'i Galilaya witwa i Nazareti,

27.text: ku mwari wari warasabwe n'umugabo witwaga Yosefu wo mu nzu ya Dawidi, izina ry'uwo mwari ni Mariya.

28.text: Amusanga aho yari ari aramubwira ati “Ni amahoro Uhiriwe, Umwami Imana iri kumwe nawe.”

29.text: Ariko we ahagarika umutima cyane w'iryo jambo, atekereza iyo ndamutso icyo ari cyo.

30.text: Marayika aramubwira ati “Witinya Mariya, kuko uhiriwe ku Mana.

31.text: Kandi dore uzasama inda, uzabyara umuhungu uzamwite Yesu.

32.text: Azaba mukuru, azitwa Umwana w'Isumbabyose kandi Umwami Imana izamuha intebe y'ubwami ya sekuruza Dawidi,

33.text: azima mu nzu ya Yakobo iteka ryose, ubwami bwe ntibuzashira.”

34.text: Mariya abaza marayika ati “Ibyo bizabaho bite ko ntararyamana n'umugabo?”

35.text: Marayika aramusubiza ati “Umwuka Wera azakuzaho, n'imbaraga z'Isumbabyose zizagukingiriza, ni cyo gituma Uwera uzavuka azitwa Umwana w'Imana.

36.text: Kandi dore mwene wanyu Elizabeti na we afite inda y'umuhungu yo mu za bukuru, uwitwaga ingumba none uku ni ukwezi kwe kwa gatandatu,

37.text: kuko ari nta jambo Imana ivuga ngo rihere.”

38.text: Mariya aramubwira ati “Dore ndi umuja w'Umwami Imana, bimbere uko uvuze.” Nuko marayika amusiga aho aragenda.

39.text: Muri iyo minsi Mariya arahaguruka agenda yihuta, ajya mu gihugu cy'urukiga mu mudugudu w'i Yudaya,

40.text: yinjira mu nzu ya Zakariya aramukanya na Elizabeti.

41.text: Maze Elizabeti yumvise indamutso ya Mariya umwana asimbagurika mu nda ye, Elizabeti yuzuzwa Umwuka Wera

42.text: avuga ijwi rirenga ati “Mu bagore urahirwa, n'imbuto yo mu nda yawe irahirwa.

43.text: Mbese ibi nabikesha iki ko nyina w'Umwami wanjye angendereye?

44.text: Ijwi ry'indamutso yawe ryinjiye mu matwi yanjye, umwana asimbaguritswa mu nda yanjye no kwishima.

45.text: Kandi hahirwa uwizeye, kuko ibyo yabwiwe n'Umwami Imana bizasohora.”

46.text: Mariya aravuga ati“Umutima wanjye uhimbaza Umwami Imana,

47.text: N'ubugingo bwanjye bwishimiye Imana umukiza wanjye,

48.text: Kuko yabonye ubukene bw'umuja wayo,Kandi uhereye none ab'ibihe byose bazanyita Uhiriwe.

49.text: Kuko Ushoborabyose ankoreye ibikomeye,N'izina rye ni iryera.

50.text: Imbabazi ze ziri ku bamwubaha,Uko ibihe bihaye ibindi.

51.text: Yerekanishije imbaraga ukuboko kwe,Atatanije abibone mu byo batekereza mu mitima yabo.

52.text: Anyaze abakomeye intebe zabo,Ashyize hejuru aboroheje.

53.text: Abashonje yabahagije ibyiza,Naho abakire yabasezereye amāra masa.

54.text: Atabaye Isirayeli umugaragu we,Kuko yibutse imbabazi ze,

55.text: Yasezeranije ba sogokuruza,Ko azazigirira Aburahamu n'urubyaro rwe iteka ryose.”

56.text: Nuko Mariya amara amezi nk'atatu kwa Elizabeti, abona gutaha.

57.text: Nuko iminsi yo kubyara kwa Elizabeti irasohora, abyara umuhungu.

58.text: Abaturanyi be na bene wabo bumva yuko Umwami Imana yamugiriye imbabazi nyinshi, bishimana na we.

59.text: Nuko ku munsi wa munani bajya gukeba umwana, bashaka kumwita izina rya se Zakariya.

60.text: Nyina arabasubiza ati “Oya, ahubwo yitwe Yohana.”

61.text: Baramubwira bati “Ko ari nta wo mu muryango wanyu witwa iryo zina!”

62.text: Bacira se amarenga kugira ngo bamubaze uko ashaka kumwita.

63.text: Atumira icyo kwandikiraho arandika ati “Izina rye ni Yohana.”

64.text: Bose baratangara. Muri ako kanya akanwa ke karazibuka, n'ururimi rwe ruragobodoka aravuga, ashima Imana.

65.text: Abaturanyi bose baterwa n'ubwoba, ibyo byose byamamara mu misozi y'i Yudaya yose.

66.text: Ababyumvise bose babishyira mu mitima yabo bati “Mbese uyu mwana azaba iki?” Nuko ukuboko k'Umwami Imana gukomeza kubana na we.

67.text: Se Zakariya yuzuzwa Umwuka Wera arahanura ati

68.text: “Umwami ahimbazwe, Imana y'Abisirayeli,Kuko igendereye abantu bayo ikabacungura.

69.text: Kandi iduhagurukirije ihembe ry'agakiza,Mu nzu y'umugaragu wayo Dawidi,

70.text: (Nk'uko yavugiye mu kanwa k'abera bayo,Bahanuraga uhereye kera kose.)

72.text: Kugirira ba sogokuruza imbabazi,No kwibuka isezerano ryayo ryera,

74.text: Ko nitumara gukizwa amaboko y'abanzi bacu,Tuzayisenga tudatinya,

75.text: Turi abera dukiranuka imbere yayo iminsi yacu yose.

76.text: “Kandi nawe mwana, uzitwa umuhanuzi w'Isumbabyose,Kuko uzabanziriza Umwami ngo utunganye inzira ze,

77.text: No kumenyesha abantu be iby'agakiza,Ko ari ukubabarirwa ibyaha byabo.

78.text: Ku bw'umutima w'imbabazi w'Imana yacu,Ni wo uzatuma umuseke udutambikira uvuye mu ijuru,

79.text: Ukamurikira abicaye mu mwijima no mu gicucu cy'urupfu,No kuyobora ibirenge byacu mu nzira y'amahoro.”

80.text: Uwo mwana arakura, agwiza imbaraga z'umutima, aguma mu butayu kugeza umunsi yerekewemo Abisirayeli.
